answer: Each identity binds one voter registration: the roll receipt hash and a delta code go on-chain, with a 30 POA bond locked 90 days. Each epoch a roll re-check is due within 72 hours; two misses freeze payouts and forfeit half the bond. A second registration from one cluster doubles the bond to 60 POA, a third to 120, capped at 960 from the sixth, so 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA, needing 100 real registrations. The Island Roll lists one person per entry, and brokered registrations follow a spiral curve doubling every 50 sold. Forgery carries criminal penalties; shared households pass joint check.
